trigger: Interact with Lolo on her porch.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Braith, maitia. You look like a man who slept in his boots. Come. Sit.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Mr. Pruitt, three houses down. Eighty-four. His oxygen machine needs a wall plug.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: His bottles run out tonight. After that he breathes on his own. He cannot.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: You have a gas can in your truck. Gil has a generator he won't share. You see where I'm going.

choices.text: That gas gets us to my dad's ranch.
Our house needs a generator too.
Ask Gil. I'll go with you.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: With the machine, months. Without it, maybe Thursday. Maybe Friday if he's stubborn.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: I'm not asking you to choose, maitia. I'm telling you a choice exists. That's all.

choices.text: That gas gets us to my dad's ranch.
Our house needs a generator too.
Ask Gil. I'll go with you.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Thank you. He'll complain about the noise. That's how you'll know he's alive.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: One more thing. He wandered off this morning. Confused. His grandson's out looking.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Your father's ranch. Of course. Family first. I would do the same.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Then you're not going anywhere either. Keep the gas. Keep it close.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: A warm house is not nothing. Fine. I would hate it too.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: I asked. He said 'listen here' and then said no for five minutes. Try. He likes mechanics.

nodes.speaker: lolo
nodes.text: Pruitt walked off at dawn. Deshawn found only this by the canal. Your dog has a nose, no?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: QUEST: Wraith can TRACK from the scarf. Tap her, then TRACK.
